name: worry
quote: I'm pretty sure she's going to get hurt.
description: Tentative negativity from a sense that an undesired outcome is possible. You don't know if that outcome likely or not, but strongly want to avoid it.
perceptions: A bad outcome is a possibility.
That would be negative for me or someone important to me.
By focusing on it, maybe I can find a way to avoid it.

guidance.description: Worry is common in the modern world, so there are many resources that may help you understand and deal with it more effectively.

examples: Worried that your friend doing an extreme sport is going to get hurt.
Worried about going to a certain area.

comparisons.description: 'Pessimism' is a perception that the most likely outcome is not your preferred one. 'Apprehension' is the anticipated sadness that comes from imagining the most likely outcome, perhaps mixed with a recognized doubt that it might not happen.

variations.name: apprehensive outlook
variations.description: A general tendency to focus on feelings generated by considering a possible negative outcome even if that outcome is not likely.
perceptions: I can protect myself by frequently considering the bad things that could come to pass.

commentaries.quote: Apprehension, uncertainty, waiting, expectation, fear of surprise, do a patient more harm than any exertion.
Worry often gives a small thing a big shadow.
There were many terrible things in my life and most of them never happened.

While excessive worry is generally seen as a negative trait and high intelligence as a positive one, worry may cause our species to avoid dangerous situations, regardless of how remote a possibility they may be.
